title: Add severity argument to `ssl_debug_printf()`
description:
Adds a severity argument to the start of the `ssl_debug_printf()`
definition and all function calls.

Current severity levels are info, warning, and error, as per the levels
given in #18272. These levels were assigned to each call of the function
based on a cursory glance at context, and may need correction in some
cases.

Note: the actual change to the presentation of log lines by severity is
currently very basic. Some calls to `ssl_debug_printf()` include leading
newline characters to distinguish f.e. the start of a new frame;
if this usage is to be kept, then the presentation of log lines may need
to be reworked.

Proposed fix for #18272

notes.body:
If the issue that we are trying to address is to make it easier to find problems, then adding a `ERROR` prefix might help, but adding `[INFO]` probably does not. At best people can consider skipping these lines, at worst it is more text to read.

I have posted some thoughts on the related issue. Maybe some cases need expert info such that we need to rely less on the debug file?
